title: 第8章 招聘第二个员工
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
尝到了芒果的美味，花期对开水果店更有信心。

    她让荣华吃完饭先去干活，自己坐在芒果树下，点开系统面板招聘第二位员工。

    芒果的最佳食用日期还有二十分钟，一般来说果子成熟后必须马上摘下，这样才能保证最佳口味，还能避免其余果子营养不良。

    但这是神奇土地，蓝星的理论不清楚能不能适用，或许情况不会变，又或许和蓝星不同。

    花期原本还想着找个干活的一把手来着，可芒果种出来了，只能先把果子摘了。

    她在面板上写写画画，输入招聘条件。

    【检索中...】

    小助的声音传来不过三秒，一条毛茸茸的大尾巴就落在花期的脑袋上。

    一股热气从头顶袭来，棕色的大尾巴在眼前一晃一晃。

    两条细腿悬在半空，没有踩到地面，腿的主人慌得到处乱踩。

    花期只觉头皮轻微刺痛，有双尖锐的爪子在扯着头发。

    “吱吱——”

    一道惊慌的叫声从头上传来，花期忍着头皮的痛，抬手抓住垂在眼前的大尾巴。

    她一扯，尾巴的主人立马炸毛了，在脑袋上动得更凶。

    一个浑身黄色的大松鼠趴在花期头顶上，双眼瞪得极大，嘴里还含着没吃完的松果。

    它惊慌地看着突然变化的树林，四肢忍不住乱晃。

    但它越慌，就越踩不稳。

    慌乱间，尾巴还被用力扯住，松鼠忍不住尖叫，松果不小心从嘴里飞了出去。

    “吱！”救命啊妈妈，熊瞎子来了，熊瞎子来了！

    “我不是熊瞎子。”

    花期吐掉飘进嘴里的松鼠毛，手臂抬到脑袋上，摸了下这个热乎的身体，抓着松鼠腰部往上一扯。

    “吱！”救命，大王救命啊！

    松鼠又发出一声尖叫。

    陡然被拉到半空，它吓得浑身毛都炸开花，立刻变成一个被电过的黄色大松鼠。

    它朝四周到处看，始终没找到危险来源在哪里。

    “小松鼠，在下面。”

    慌乱的松鼠一低头，两个豆豆眼便和下方一双含笑的眼睛对上。

    它的尖叫像是被卡在喉咙里，瞬间不叫了。
content_en:
After tasting the deliciousness of mangoes, Hua Qi became more confident about opening a fruit shop.

    She asked Ronghua to go to work after dinner, while she sat under the mango tree and clicked on the system panel to recruit a second employee.

    The best before date of mangoes is twenty minutes. Generally speaking, the fruits must be picked immediately after they are ripe, so as to ensure the best taste and avoid malnutrition of other fruits.

    But this is a magical land, and it’s not clear whether Blue Star’s theory can be applied. Maybe the situation will not change, or maybe it’s different from Blue Star.

    In the flower period, I originally wanted to find a top worker, but after the mangoes were planted, I had to pick the fruits first.

    She wrote and drew on the panel and entered the recruitment conditions.

    【Searching...】

    Within three seconds of Kosuke's voice coming, a big fluffy tail landed on Kaori's head.

    A wave of heat hit him from the top of his head, and his big brown tail swayed in front of his eyes.

    The two thin legs were hanging in the air without touching the ground. The owner of the legs was so panicked that they stepped on them everywhere.

    During the flowering period, I only felt a slight tingling on my scalp, and a pair of sharp claws were pulling my hair.

    "Zhizhi——"

    A panicked cry came from the head. Huaqi endured the pain in her scalp and raised her hand to grab the big tail hanging in front of her eyes.

    As soon as she pulled it, the owner of the tail immediately became hairy and moved even more fiercely on his head.

    A big yellow squirrel was lying on top of Hua Qi's head, its eyes widened and there were still uneaten pine cones in its mouth.

    It looked at the sudden change in the woods in panic, and its limbs couldn't help but sway.

    But the more panicked it becomes, the less stable it becomes.

    In the panic, the tail was pulled hard, and the squirrel couldn't help but scream, and the pine cone accidentally flew out of its mouth.

    "Squeak!" Help, mom, the blind bear is coming, the blind bear is coming!

    "I'm not a blind bear."

    Hua Qi spit out the squirrel hair that floated into her mouth, raised her arms to her head, touched the warm body, grabbed the squirrel's waist and pulled it up.

    "Squeak!" Help, Your Majesty, help!

    The squirrel screamed again.

    Suddenly being pulled into the air, it was so frightened that the fur all over its body exploded, and it immediately turned into a big yellow squirrel that had been electrocuted.

    It looked around but could not find the source of danger.

    "Little squirrel, down there."

    As soon as the panicked squirrel lowered his head, his two beady eyes met a pair of smiling eyes below.

    Its scream seemed to be stuck in its throat, and it stopped screaming instantly.
